title: Choose u
text: Let $$u=arcsin(t)$$, so $$du=\frac{dt}{\sqrt{1-t^2}}$$. The limits become $$u=0$$ and $$u=\frac{\pi}{6}$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The integral of tan(u) from $$0$$ to $$\frac{\pi}{6}$$ is $$-\ln\left(cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right)=-\ln\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)=\frac{1}{2} \ln\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)$$.
